title: policy.json: the org policy, one source of truth (krizaka-internal#2781)
description: The org policy read by every guard, cron and CI job. Closed on purpose: an unknown key is refused, no value is free text, and nothing here is a secret, a machine path, a URL (except the operator consoles of observability.environments, pinned by enum), product display data or public discovery data. Each value is explained in docs/standards/policy.md.

$schema.description: Where the schema is, relative to policy.json. Read by editors only; no tool follows it.

version.description: The shape of this file. A reader refuses a version it does not know. Unit: a whole number, raised when a key is renamed or removed.

train.description: How pull requests queue and land. Read by the PR cap check (CI, scripts/pr-cap.mjs), by krizaka-agents (kz.PR_CAP, pr-open, the train, the watchdog, the crack metrics) and shown by the cockpit.

prCapPerLane.description: The most open pull requests one lane may hold in one repository. A new pull request that would be the next one over fails the PR cap check. Unit: pull requests, 1 to 10.

capScope.description: What the cap counts. lane-per-repository: the open pull requests of one lane (its lane:<name> label) in one repository; a Dependabot pull request without a lane label counts in the lane « dependabot », any other unlabelled one in the lane « unlabelled ».

fixMainExempt.description: Whether a fix(main) pull request (title fix(main) or label fix-main) is neither blocked by the cap nor counted in it, so a red main can always be repaired. true or false.

observability.description: Where the org's observability lives and how strictly dashboards are checked (ADR-028). Read by the cockpit, the agents' tools (the Security, Observability & SRE lane, the provisioning and probe scripts) and the dashboards check of @krizaka/config.

provider.description: The observability provider behind the consoles. The vendor is a value, never a name in code or keys (functional names).

dashboards.description: How the dashboards check (krizaka-dashboards check, @krizaka/config) enforces the reading surfaces of every deployed repository.

enforcement.description: warn: findings are printed, the push and CI pass; block: a finding fails the push and CI. warn until every deployed repository is green (ADR-028 §5).

environments.description: One Grafana per environment (ADR-028 §2). dev is the Canadian stack that exists; prod waits for the founder's decision.

dev.description: One environment's Grafana. state: live (its console exists) or to-create (the founder has not decided the stack yet: no console, the readers show « à créer »).

state.description: Whether this environment's stack exists. live: the console below is set and read; to-create: no stack yet (a money and account decision of the founder, ADR-028).

console.description: The https origin of this environment's Grafana console: no path, no query, no credential. The one place the address is written (ADR-028 §2); a link is this origin plus Grafana's own path (/d/<uid>, /a/…, /alerting/list). Pinned here: a new stack is a schema change the founder reviews (CODEOWNERS).

prod.description: One environment's Grafana. state: live (its console exists) or to-create (the founder has not decided the stack yet: no console, the readers show « à créer »).

state.description: Whether this environment's stack exists. live: the console below is set and read; to-create: no stack yet (a money and account decision of the founder, ADR-028).
